title: First cluster rules: canary the archive candidates, start the slow group
notes: The crossover begins here. Every flag below has been on with fallthrough false and evaluated since 16 August, so the true line now rises against a false line that already exists rather than appearing from nothing.

demo-email-notifications-v2 and demo-tax-calculation-v2 are the earliest track: they must complete rollout by 22-24 August so seven days of targeting stability can pass before code removal, then evaluations reach zero, then a seven-day silence window completes. They take the Staging and Production canaries together today and advance daily.

The three open-track flags take only the Staging canary and will crawl one cluster every day or two, so they are still visibly mid-crossover on 5 October. That is the whole point of the open track: something unfinished to show live.

Production canary is prod-eu-west-02 at five per cent of population, the smallest cluster. Rolling out least-populated first makes the curve accelerate rather than step evenly: 5, 15, 30, 60, 100 per cent.
